clips.title: 七周少18万亿：他却说熊市撑不住，这不是估值重估

subtitles.en: There's panic in markets. Panic creates distortion and opportunity, particularly when that panic might be misplaced.
subtitles.zh: 市场出现恐慌。恐慌带来扭曲和机会，尤其当这种恐慌可能站不住脚时。

subtitles.en: I'm Mark Cudmore and the executive editor for the market's live team. The team globally responsible for macro markets analysis within Bloomberg News.
subtitles.zh: 我是Mark Cudmore，市场直播团队执行编辑。该团队在全球范围内负责彭博新闻的宏观市场分析。

subtitles.en: We are seeing panic across financial markets at the moment with $18 trillion wiped out off the value of global stock markets within the space of just less than seven weeks.
subtitles.zh: 目前金融市场普遍恐慌，全球权益资产市值在不到七周内蒸发18万亿美元。

subtitles.en: The Nasdaq 100 index fell almost 20% while the pain across the Asian tech space has often been even greater.
subtitles.zh: 纳斯达克100指数下跌近20%，而亚洲科技板块的跌幅往往更大。

subtitles.en: What has fundamentally changed? Well, global growth is holding up okay.
subtitles.zh: 基本面发生了什么变化？全球增长其实保持得还不错。

subtitles.en: We're seeing the data come in strong, including on the job side. Earnings have been incredibly strong and in forecast for next year often getting raised.
subtitles.zh: 数据表现强劲，包括就业方面。盈利一直非常强劲，明年的预测也常常被上调。

subtitles.en: We're seeing energy prices come lower, we're seeing yields come lower.
subtitles.zh: 能源价格在走低，收益率也在走低。

subtitles.en: So fundamentally, the picture is getting better at the margin and yet we're seeing this massive slump in equity prices.
subtitles.zh: 所以从根本上说，边际情况在好转，然而我们却看到权益资产价格大幅下挫。

subtitles.en: It is impossible for a bear market to sustain when growth is good and earnings are strong.
subtitles.zh: 当增长良好且盈利强劲时，熊市不可能持续。
en_highlights: growth is good and earnings are strong

subtitles.en: Now, it is true that economists and equity analysts are frequently lagging indicators at the turn of the cycle.
subtitles.zh: 诚然，经济学家和权益分析师在周期转折点往往是滞后指标。

subtitles.en: Is that happening here? There are some stress in the NeoCloud space and across the tech space in terms of funding.
subtitles.zh: 这种情况会发生吗？云服务领域和整个科技领域在资金方面存在一些压力。

subtitles.en: But there's no real sign yet but there's a break in cash.
subtitles.zh: 但目前还没有真正迹象，只是现金方面出现断裂。

subtitles.en: Overall, the build out for next year in the AI space is largely pre-funded and the hyperscators generate a lot of fresh cash
subtitles.zh: 总体而言，明年AI领域的建设大部分已预先融资，超大规模企业每月产生大量新现金。

subtitles.en: every month. This isn't the bubble bursting.

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
